title: Dukkaraṃ (or Kummo)
text: Dukkaraṃ duttitikkhañca || avyattena ca sāmaññaṃ || bahū hi tattha sambādhā || yattha bālo visīdatīti || || Kati-haṃ careyya sāmaññaṃ || cittaṃ ce na nivāreyya || pade pade visīdeyya || saṅkappānaṃ vasānugo || || Kummo va aṅgāni sake kapāle || samodahaṃ bhikkhu mano-vitakke || anissito aññam aheṭhayāno || parinibbuto na upavadeyya kañcīti || ||
